userProfile.title: UserProfile
userProfile.description: User profile and examination study settings for RBT candidates.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

targetExamDate.description: Target date for the Tennessee RBT exam.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last modified.

examAttempt.title: ExamAttempt
examAttempt.description: Record of a completed or in-progress RBT Practice Exam attempt.

userId.description: User UID who took the exam.

passedBenchmark.description: True if score is >= 80% passing benchmark.

mode.description: Whether taken in instant feedback, timed exam, or adaptive quiz mode.

intervalSession.title: IntervalSession
intervalSession.description: Interval measurement simulation trial results tracking discontinuous measurement bias.

userId.description: User UID who performed the simulation.

scenarioName.description: Name of student behavioral scenario (e.g. Maya, Liam).

biasRecognized.description: Whether candidate recognized PIR overestimation and WIR underestimation.

studySession.title: StudySession
studySession.description: Focused study timer logs for candidate consistency tracking.

userId.description: User UID who logged the study session.

durationMinutes.description: Elapsed focused study time in minutes.

studyArea.description: Primary RBT Task List study area (e.g. Measurement, Assessment, Skill Acquisition, Behavior Reduction, Documentation & Reporting, Ethics).

topic.description: Specific study domain or task list area.

completed.description: Whether session reached planned timer duration.

dataSheet.title: DataSheet
dataSheet.description: Customized clinical data collection sheet created by the RBT.

userId.description: User UID who created the sheet.

studentName.description: Initials or pseudonym of the student.

graphRecord.title: GraphRecord
graphRecord.description: User customized progress monitoring graph sandbox configuration.

userId.description: User UID who saved the graph.

adaptiveMistake.title: AdaptiveMistake
adaptiveMistake.description: Tracked incorrect answer for adaptive quiz review and study guide recommendations.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

questionId.description: ID of the missed exam question.

taskListCode.description: BACB Task List item code (e.g. A-1, A-2, A-3).

selectedAnswerIndex.description: Index of option selected by user.

suggestedModuleId.description: ID of study guide module to review.

mistakeCount.description: Cumulative times this question was answered incorrectly.

resolved.description: Whether question was answered correctly in subsequent retry.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and exam study settings.

/users/{userId}/examAttempts/{attemptId}.description: Practice exam attempts and diagnostic scores for candidate progress monitoring.

/users/{userId}/adaptiveMistakes/{mistak.description: Historical incorrect answers tracked for adaptive quiz recommendation engine.

/users/{userId}/intervalSessions/{sessio.description: Interval lab performance metrics tracking discontinuous measurement bias mastery.

/users/{userId}/studySessions/{studyId}.description: Focused study timer logs tracking candidate preparation hours.

/users/{userId}/dataSheets/{sheetId}.description: Customized clinical data sheets saved by the candidate.

/users/{userId}/graphs/{graphId}.description: Custom single-case graph designs and progress monitoring analyses.
